visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Regular Expression Instead of a Character Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A function checks every character to see whether the text consists only of digits. Replace the loop with one regular expression. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: ^\d+$ says "one or more digits and nothing else", so the empty-text check, the loop and the character comparisons are all covered by the pattern.
